description: This is a C# source file (Program.cs) setting up a web API using ASP.NET Core. It configures services, API endpoints, health checks, Swagger documentation, CORS, and database integration for a data asset management system. The code includes route definitions for assets, master data, health endpoints, and utility functions for environment variable loading.

classes.name: ValidityCheckRequest
classes.description: Request payload for the validity check endpoint, containing a single string 'Value' to validate.

classes.name: ValidityCheckResponse
classes.description: Response payload indicating whether the value is valid and an optional reason for invalidity.

classes.name: HealthRootResponse
classes.description: Response payload for the root health check endpoint, indicating overall service status.

classes.name: HealthzDbStatus
classes.description: Details about database configuration and health for health check reporting.

classes.name: HealthzResponse
classes.description: Composite health check response including status and database diagnostics.

methods.name: LoadDotEnvIfPresent
methods.description: Utility method to load environment variables from a .env file if present.

methods.name: BuildPublishedServerUrl
methods.description: Constructs the server URL to be advertised in OpenAPI documentation, respecting environment overrides and forwarded headers.

methods.name: ConfigureOpenApiDocument
methods.description: Configures the OpenAPI document server URL dynamically based on incoming request.
